static_traits.name: Chen Kaiwen
static_traits.family_status: Lives in a rural area, has several children and a dog; the parents are still married; keeps in contact with the parents
static_traits.social_status: Supportive connection with parents, but feeling discomfort when discussing relationship topics; difficulty forming new relationships due to a sense of inadequacy
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness history; no psychotherapy received before; the stress of Divorce two years ago triggered feelings of inadequacy about relationships
static_traits.language_features: Neutral attitude, clear expression, capable of self-Reflection and cooperation; steady speech rate; but often describes self and others with negative labels and hypothetical thinking

basic_info.main_problem: I feel inadequate in intimate relationships, especially compared to my parents' seemingly solid marriage. These feelings began with my Divorce two years ago and have been intensified by my parents' enduring marital happiness. I often experience these feelings when discussing relationships with my parents or Seeing happy couples.
basic_info.core_demands: Realizing these feelings are affecting my self-worth and Interpersonal relationships, I am seeking counseling now; and hoping to talk more openly with my parents about my feelings.
growth_experiences: Experienced Divorce two years ago with emotional turmoil and high stress, after which feelings of inadequacy in intimate relationships began; the problem has worsened over time.
Parents' marriage remains stable with Good interactions; observing my parents together highlights my own sense of relationship failure, intensifying Self-denial.
Living in a rural area, raising several children and a dog; can usually rely on parents' support, but feels unsafe and uncomfortable expressing feelings to parents when relationship topics arise.

core_beliefs: I am doomed to fail in intimate relationships
Only by having a stable marriage like my parents do I have worth

special_situations.event: When with parents or seeing happy couples
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not have a stable marriage like my parents', it means I am not good enough, a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids discussing relationships with parents; tries to boost self-esteem by reading self-help books and positive affirmations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them; I am a failure in relationships

special_situations.event: Discussing intimate relationship topics with parents
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I divorce, my parents will surely look down on me, believing I am incompetent in relationships
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids open communication with parents, to protect self-image and reduce the risk of being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am terrible/useless

special_situations.event: Thinking about future intimate relationships or trying to build new ones
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have failed once before, it means I will fail again in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing active attempts to build new relationships, with Withdrawal and Self-denial
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never succeed in relationships

special_situations.event: Parents offer support, not yet making negative comments about my relationship situation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only a perfect and lasting marriage can prove my worth; all other positive information does not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores support from parents and neutral feedback, continues to define myself with negative labels
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This comfort is useless; I am essentially a failure

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be accepted and affirmed by parents and significant others, proving that they are valuable in intimate relationships
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being judged a failure, looked down upon, or Being rejected
defense_goal: Lowering the risk of being judged and maintaining fragile self-esteem boundaries by avoiding intimate topics and Self-denial

object_relations.self_representation: A 'failure' defined by Divorce, a not-good-enough child/partner
object_relations.object_representation: Idealized parents/others who may judge me (seen in the mind as judges)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked or advised to talk openly with parents about the relationship, or when discussing parents' possible views
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Projecting my own Self-denial and sense of failure onto my parents, believing they see me as a failure (transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use hypothetical and speculative statements (e.g., 'they must think I am awful'), in a cautious tone, avoiding direct verification or emotional exposure, slightly skirting concrete facts.

manifestations: Since Divorce, feeling different from others with failure highlighted when Seeing happy couples or Getting along with parents
Difficulty building new relationships, feeling uncomfortable with parents when relationship topics arise
Seeing Divorce as a 'failure' label and negating positive support
Feeling that I 'will never succeed in relationships'
outcomes: Lowers willingness and action to build new relationships

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Believing parents look down on me, although they never give negative feedback and are actually quite supportive
Using others' assumed opinions to Interpretation my own sense of inadequacy

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Overly harsh on oneself with the 'failure' self-label
Over-worrying about parents' opinions and not daring to communicate openly, appearing cautious and hesitant on relationship topics

positive_force: Parents are overall quite supportive, providing dependable social support
Willing to try open communication and reality testing (expresses willingness in counseling)
Having self-Reflection ability, able to identify negative thinking patterns
Tries to raise self-esteem through self-help books and positive affirmations, with motivation to change
negative_force: Excessive comparison and labeling, highly binding self-worth to marital success or failure
Mind reading and predicting the future, often assuming others' negative views and prophesying continued failure
Avoids direct communication with parents, seeks external validation but ignores actual support
Emotional burden affects daily focus and actions toward building new relationships

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Self-denial and avoiding communication when with parents or Seeing happy couples
target_behavior.core_reason: Tying self-worth to marital success/failure after Divorce two years ago, developing negative cognitions (overgeneralization, comparison, mind reading, predicting the future) when comparing with parents' stable marriage
target_behavior.function: Short-term avoidance of judgment and emotional discomfort, protecting fragile self-esteem
target_behavior.consequence: Difficulty building new relationships, persistent low self-esteem and Anxiety, declining focus on daily tasks

target_behavior.behavior: Negative Anticipation of future relationships and behavioral Withdrawal
antecedent: Situations of considering building new relationships
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralizing one failure into permanent failure, viewing future relationships through negative prophecy
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential failure and shame, lowering present Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Reduces attempts and actions; social connection and intimate satisfaction are blocked
